# Study 1 
## Import dataset
```{r}
##Study 1
d3<-read.csv(file="A-PLANT_formerging_20261118.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings=c("999", "99", "", "X","NA"))
d3$Prestorer_Shape<-ifelse(d3$Prestorer_Color=="Purple",1,0)
d3$Study<-1
d3$ID <- sprintf("S%03d", 1:nrow(d3))#create ID from S001 to S153

ds<-d3

```


## Demographics

```{r}
describe(ds$Age)
ds$Gender<-factor(ds$Gender, levels = c(1,2,3,4), labels = c("Male", "Female", "Non-binary", "Other"))
prop.table(table(ds$Gender))*100 #Female=2
prop.table(table(ds$Race))*100
prop.table(table(ds$Income))*100 #low income households are 1+2 (40.000 or less a year)
prop.table(table(ds$Education))*100 #Without a higher education degree 1+2+3 
prop.table(table(ds$Context))*100 #might not include in demographics 
```
## Moral evaluation of the actors
```{r}
#### Bad guy ####
#Binomial test -Model to check whether the proportion of participants choosing the plant harmer is significantly different from 0.5.
#number of successes
num_successes <- sum(ds$badplantharmer == 1)
# Total number of participants
n <- length(ds$badplantharmer)
# Null hypothesis proportion (0.5 for a binary choice)
p_null <- 0.5
# Perform the binomial test
binom.test(num_successes, n, p = p_null)
#Effect size
p0 <- p_null  # Null hypothesis proportion (chance level=0.5)
p1 <- num_successes/n  #observed proportion
ES.h(p1, p0)  # Effect size using Cohen's h for proportions

```

#Moral evaluation of the action
```{r}
#### Severity of harm ####
describe(cbind(ds$Sever_Plant_harm,ds$Sever_Pot_harm))
#Paired t-test
shapiro.test(ds$Sever_Plant_harm)#not normal but just for curiosity do the parametric
shapiro.test(ds$Sever_Pot_harm)
#non parametic option
wilcox.test(ds$Sever_Plant_harm,ds$Sever_Pot_harm, paired = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")#p<.05 
#effect size needs long format data
ds_long <- ds %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Sever_Plant_harm, Sever_Pot_harm),
               names_to = "patient",
               values_to = "severity_h")
#Effect size
wilcox_test(ds_long, severity_h ~ patient, paired = TRUE,alternative = "two.sided")
wilcox_effsize(ds_long, severity_h ~ patient, paired = TRUE)


#### Severity of restore ####
describe(cbind(ds$Sever_Plant_rest,ds$Sever_Pot_rest))
#Paired t-test
shapiro.test(ds$Sever_Plant_rest)#not normal but just for curiosity do the parametric
shapiro.test(ds$Sever_Pot_rest)
#non parametic option
wilcox.test(ds$Sever_Plant_rest,ds$Sever_Pot_rest, paired = TRUE, alternative = "two.sided")#p<.05 but for effect size need the data in long format
#effect size need to be calculated in long format data
ds_long_res <- ds %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Sever_Plant_rest, Sever_Pot_rest),
               names_to = "patient",
               values_to = "severity_r")
#Effect size
wilcox_test(ds_long_res, severity_r ~ patient, paired = TRUE,alternative = "two.sided")
wilcox_effsize(ds_long_res, severity_r ~ patient, paired = TRUE)

```



#Study 2 and 3
## Import datasets
```{r}
##Study 2
d1<-read.csv(file="K-PLANT_1_formerging_20261118.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings=c("999", "99", "", "X","NA"))
d1$Prestorer_Shape<-ifelse(d1$Prestorer_Color=="Purple",1,0)
d1$Prestorer_Shape<-as.factor(d1$Prestorer_Shape)
d1$Study<-2


##Study 3
d2<-read.csv(file="K-PLANT_2_formerging_20261118.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings=c("999", "99", "", "X","NA"))
d2$Study<-3
d2$Prestorer_Shape<-ifelse(d2$Prestorer_Shape== "Circle", 1, 0)
d2$Prestorer_Shape<-as.factor(d2$Prestorer_Shape)

vars_needed <- c(
  "ID",
  # predictors
  "Study", "Bio_Pla_dif","Bio_control","Mind_Pla","Mind_Pla_dif", "AgeM_cent",
  "Prestorer_Order", "Prestorer_Shape", "Maction_Order",
  # outcomes
  "likeplantrestorer", "friendplantrestorer",
  "badplantharmer",
  "Sever_Plant_harm", "Sever_Pot_harm",
  "Sever_Plant_rest", "Sever_Pot_rest","PVT_cent","Forced_worse_rev","Forced_better_rev"
)

# Subset each dataset to just these variables (and keep only those that exist)
d1_sub <- d1 %>% select(any_of(vars_needed))
d2_sub <- d2 %>% select(any_of(vars_needed))

d1_sub <- d1_sub %>% mutate(ID_new = paste0("A_", ID))
d2_sub <- d2_sub %>% mutate(ID_new = paste0("B_", ID))
dsc <- bind_rows(d1_sub, d2_sub)
#Exclude participants failing control questions for biology analyses
dsb<-dsc[dsc$Bio_control==4,]

#Center and standardize biology, mind and age  before using it in the interactions
dsb$Bio_Pla_dif_cent <- dsb$Bio_Pla_dif - mean(dsb$Bio_Pla_dif, na.rm = TRUE)
dsb$Bio_Pla_dif_z <- scale(dsb$Bio_Pla_dif, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
dsb$Mind_Pla_dif_cent <- dsb$Mind_Pla_dif - mean(dsb$Mind_Pla_dif, na.rm = TRUE)
dsb$Mind_Pla_dif_z <- scale(dsb$Mind_Pla_dif, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
dsb$AgeM_cent_z <- scale(dsb$AgeM_cent, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
dsb$PVT_cent_z<-scale(dsb$PVT_cent, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

#Factor Study number
dsb$Study<-as.factor(dsb$Study)

```

## Demographics 
```{r}
## Study 2
describe(d1$Age..Y.)
describe(d1$Age..M.)
prop.table(table(d1$Gender))*100
#To calculate race first compute the multiracial category
d1 <- d1 %>%
  mutate(
    Race_grouped = case_when(
      is.na(Race) ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(Race, ",") ~ "Multiracial",
      Race == "Multiracial" ~ "Multiracial",
      TRUE ~ Race
    )
  )
prop.table(table(d1$Race_grouped, useNA = "ifany")) * 100
d1$lowincome<-ifelse(d1$Income<=40000,1,0)
prop.table(table(d1$lowincome))*100 #low income households are 1+2 (40.000 or less a year)
d1$Income<-as.numeric(d1$Income)
prop.table(table(d1$P1_Education))*100 # 
prop.table(table(d1$P2_Education))*100 # 

## Study 3
describe(d2$Age..Y.)
describe(d2$Age..M.)
prop.table(table(d2$Gender))*100
#To calculate race first compute the multiracial category
d2 <- d2 %>%
  mutate(
    Race_grouped = case_when(
      is.na(Race) ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(Race, ",") ~ "Multiracial",
      Race == "Multiracial" ~ "Multiracial",
      TRUE ~ Race
    )
  )
prop.table(table(d2$Race_grouped, useNA = "ifany")) * 100
```

```{r}

n <- length(d2$badplantharmer)-sum(is.na(d2$badplantharmer))
```

## Effect of biology knowledge and age
```{r}
#### Evaluation of the actor ####
#Include the Study in case it makes a difference
summary(model1<-glm(badplantharmer ~ Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order, data = dsb, family = binomial))
summary(model1<-glm(badplantharmer ~ Bio_Pla_dif + Study+Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order, data = dsb, family = binomial))
exp(cbind(OR=coef(model1), confint(model1)))
#Adding age to the model
summary(model1<-glm(badplantharmer ~ Bio_Pla_dif + AgeM_cent+ Study + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order, data = dsb, family = binomial))
exp(cbind(OR=coef(model1), confint(model1)))

#### Evaluation of the action ####
#Harm
dsb_long <- dsb %>% #create long format data
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Sever_Plant_harm, Sever_Pot_harm),
               names_to = "patient",
               values_to = "severity_h")

dsb_long$patient <- factor(dsb_long$patient, levels = c("Sever_Plant_harm", "Sever_Pot_harm"),
                           labels = c("Plant", "Bucket"))
#Control for Study in case it makes a difference
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_h ~ patient*Bio_Pla_dif_z+ Study + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long))
#Explore further the interaction
# Estimate the slope of Biology within each patient group
slopes_bio<-emtrends(model1, ~ patient, var = "Bio_Pla_dif_z") #If there were more than 2 patients I could compare the pairwise slopes but 
emtrends(model1, ~ patient, var = "Bio_Pla_dif_z")
test(emtrends(model1, ~ patient, var = "Bio_Pla_dif_z")) #simple slopes were not significant then try at different levels of the bio value

#Now look at different bio values
bio_vals <- c(-1, 0, 1)   # replace with values meaningful for bio

emm <- emmeans(model1, ~ patient | Bio_Pla_dif_z,
               at = list(Bio_Pla_dif_z = bio_vals))
contrast(emm, "pairwise") 

#Model without the interaction
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_h ~ patient+Bio_Pla_dif + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long))

#Model controlling for the interaction with age
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_h ~ patient*Bio_Pla_dif_z+patient*AgeM_cent_z+ Study + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long))

#Restore
dsb_long_res <- dsb %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Sever_Plant_rest, Sever_Pot_rest),
               names_to = "patient",
               values_to = "severity_r")
dsb_long_res$patient <- factor(dsb_long_res$patient, levels = c("Sever_Plant_rest", "Sever_Pot_rest"),
                           labels = c("Plant", "Bucket"))

#Control for Study type in case it makes a difference
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_r ~ patient + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long_res))

summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_r ~ patient*Bio_Pla_dif_z+Study+ Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long_res))
#Model without the interaction
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_r ~ patient+Bio_Pla_dif_z+Study + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long_res))

#Model controlling for the interaction with age
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_r ~ patient*Bio_Pla_dif_z+patient*AgeM_cent_z+Study + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long_res))

#### Correlation of biology and age ####
cor.test(dsb$Bio_Pla_dif,dsb$AgeM_cent, method = "spearman")
```

```{r}
               names_to = "patient",
```

#### Social preferences and Counterbalanced factors' effects 
```{r}
#### Like ####
#Binomial test - Model to check whether the proportion of participants choosing the plant restorer is significantly different from 0.5.
#number of successes
num_successes <- sum(ds$likeplantrestorer == 1)
# Total number of participants
n <- length(ds$likeplantrestorer)
# Null hypothesis proportion (0.5 for a binary choice)
p_null <- 0.5
# Perform the binomial test
binom.test(num_successes, n, p = p_null)
#Effect size
p0 <- p_null  # Null hypothesis proportion (chance level=0.5)
p1 <- num_successes/n  #observed proportion
ES.h(p1, p0)  # Effect size using Cohen's h for proportions

#model to check the preference controlling for three factors counterbalanced
summary(model1<-glm(likeplantrestorer ~ Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Color + Maction_Order, data = ds, family = binomial))
# Simplified model to check overall preference
summary(model1 <- glm(likeplantrestorer ~ 1, data = ds, family = binomial))

#### Trust ####
#Binomial test - Model to check whether the proportion of participants choosing the plant restorer is significantly different from 0.5.
#number of successes
num_successes <- sum(ds$trustplantrestorer == 1)
# Total number of participants
n <- length(ds$trustplantrestorer)
# Null hypothesis proportion (0.5 for a binary choice)
p_null <- 0.5
# Perform the binomial test
binom.test(num_successes, n, p = p_null)
#Effect size
p0 <- p_null  # Null hypothesis proportion (chance level=0.5)
p1 <- num_successes/n  #observed proportion
ES.h(p1, p0)  # Effect size using Cohen's h for proportions

#model to check the preference controlling for three factors counterbalanced
summary(model1<-glm(trustplantrestorer ~ Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Color + Maction_Order, data = ds, family = binomial))
# Simplified model to check overall preference
summary(model1 <- glm(trustplantrestorer ~ 1, data = ds, family = binomial))

#### Community ####
```

## Effect of biology knowledge and age
```{r}
#Only look at Study 2
dsbs2<-dsb[dsb$Study==2,]
#### Evaluation of the actor ####
summary(model1<-glm(badplantharmer ~ Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order, data = dsbs2, family = binomial))
summary(model1<-glm(badplantharmer ~ Bio_Pla_dif + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order, data = dsbs2, family = binomial))
exp(cbind(OR=coef(model1), confint(model1)))
#Adding age to the model
summary(model1<-glm(badplantharmer ~ Bio_Pla_dif + AgeM_cent+ Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order, data = dsbs2, family = binomial))
exp(cbind(OR=coef(model1), confint(model1)))

#### Evaluation of the action ####
#Harm
dsb_long <- dsbs2 %>% #create long format data
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Sever_Plant_harm, Sever_Pot_harm),
               names_to = "patient",
               values_to = "severity_h")

dsb_long$patient <- factor(dsb_long$patient, levels = c("Sever_Plant_harm", "Sever_Pot_harm"),
                           labels = c("Plant", "Bucket"))
#Control for Study in case it makes a difference
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_h ~ patient*Bio_Pla_dif_z + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long))
#Explore further the interaction
# Estimate the slope of Biology within each patient group
slopes_bio<-emtrends(model1, ~ patient, var = "Bio_Pla_dif_z") #If there were more than 2 patients I could compare the pairwise slopes but 
emtrends(model1, ~ patient, var = "Bio_Pla_dif_z")
test(emtrends(model1, ~ patient, var = "Bio_Pla_dif_z")) #simple slopes were not significant then try at different levels of the bio value

#Now look at different bio values
bio_vals <- c(-1, 0, 1)   # replace with values meaningful for bio

emm <- emmeans(model1, ~ patient | Bio_Pla_dif_z,
               at = list(Bio_Pla_dif_z = bio_vals))
contrast(emm, "pairwise") 

#Model controlling for the interaction with age
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_h ~ patient*Bio_Pla_dif_z+patient*AgeM_cent_z+ Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long))

#Restore

                           labels = c("Plant", "Bucket"))

#Control for Study type in case it makes a difference
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_r ~ patient + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long_res))

summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_r ~ patient*Bio_Pla_dif_z+ Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long_res))

# Estimate the slope of Biology within each patient group

emtrends(model1, ~ patient, var = "Bio_Pla_dif_z")
test(emtrends(model1, ~ patient, var = "Bio_Pla_dif_z")) 

#Now look at different bio values
bio_vals <- c(-1, 0, 1)   # replace with values meaningful for bio

emm <- emmeans(model1, ~ patient | Bio_Pla_dif_z,
               at = list(Bio_Pla_dif_z = bio_vals))
contrast(emm, "pairwise")
```

#Plots
```{r}
#merge adult and children data
dsc <- dsc[, names(dsc) != "Prestorer_Shape"]

dsall <- bind_rows(ds, dsc)

# --- 1. Compute proportions per study ---------------------------------------
plot_data <- dsall %>%
  filter(!is.na(badplantharmer)) %>%
  group_by(Study) %>%
  summarise(
    harmer   = mean(badplantharmer == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,   # % answering 1 (plant harmer)
    restorer = mean(badplantharmer == 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,   # % answering 0 (plant restorer)
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(harmer, restorer),
    names_to = "answer",
    values_to = "percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    answer = factor(answer,
                    levels = c("restorer", "harmer"),   # restorer stacked on top
                    labels = c("Plant restorer", "Plant harmer")),
    Study = factor(
  as.character(Study),
  levels = c("1", "2", "3"),
  labels = c("Adults S1", "Children S2", "Children S3")
)
  )

# Star labels: placed in the middle of the orange (harmer) segment
stars <- plot_data %>%
  filter(answer == "Plant harmer") %>%
  mutate(y_pos = 60,
         label = "***")

# --- 2. Plot -----------------------------------------------------------------
Fig2<-ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Study, y = percent, fill = answer)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_text(data = stars,
            aes(x = Study, y = y_pos, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 7, colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Plant restorer" = "#C86FA6",   # rose
               "Plant harmer"   = "#E69F00")   # orange
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) + 
  labs(title = "Who is the bad guy?",
       x = "",
       y = NULL,                               # % now lives in the tick labels
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
#Edited for sharing 
ggsave(filename = "includepath.png",
       plot     = Fig2,
       width    = 3.1,
       height   = 4,
       units    = "in",
       dpi      = 300,
       bg       = "white")


#### Severity judgements adults ####
eval_long <- d3 %>%
  select(Sever_Plant_harm, Sever_Pot_harm, Sever_Plant_rest, Sever_Pot_rest) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols          = everything(),
    names_to      = c("Target", "Action"),
    names_pattern = "Sever_(Plant|Pot)_(harm|rest)",
    values_to     = "rating"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rating)) %>%
  mutate(
    Target = factor(Target, levels = c("Plant", "Pot"),
                    labels = c("plant", "artifact")),
    Action = factor(Action, levels = c("harm", "rest"),
                    labels = c("Knocking Down", "Restoring"))
  )

# Stars above each panel
stars <- data.frame(
  Action = factor(c("Knocking Down", "Restoring"),
                  levels = c("Knocking Down", "Restoring")),
  x      = 1.5,
  y      = 6.6,
  label  = "***"
)

# --- 2. Plot -----------------------------------------------------------------
Fig2.2 <- ggplot(eval_long, aes(x = Target, y = rating, fill = Target)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.75, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6,
               outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0.05, shape = 21,
              fill = "white", colour = "grey30", alpha = 0.7, size = 1.3) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point",
               shape = 23,              # filled diamond
               size = 2,
               fill = "darkred",
               colour = "darkred",        # thin outline so it stands out on the box
               stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = stars, aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Action, strip.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("plant" = "#009E73", "artifact" = "#F0E442")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:6,
    labels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(1, 6.8)) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    strip.placement    = "outside",
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey91", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.spacing      = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    legend.position    = "none"
  )

#Edited for sharing
ggsave(filename = "includepath.png",
       plot     = Fig2.2,
       width    = 5,
       height   = 4,
       units    = "in",
       dpi      = 300,
       bg       = "white")

  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    strip.placement    = "outside",
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey91", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.spacing      = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    legend.position    = "none"
  )


ggsave(filename = "includepath.png",
       plot     = Fig2.3,
       width    = 5,
       height   = 4,
       units    = "in",
       dpi      = 300,
       bg       = "white")

#### interaction with biology ####
dsb_long <- dsb %>% #create long format data
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Sever_Plant_harm, Sever_Pot_harm),
               names_to = "patient",
               values_to = "severity_h")

dsb_long$patient <- factor(dsb_long$patient, levels = c("Sever_Plant_harm", "Sever_Pot_harm"),
                           labels = c("Plant", "Bucket"))

bio_per_child <- dsb_long %>% distinct(ID, Bio_Pla_dif)
m_bio  <- mean(bio_per_child$Bio_Pla_dif, na.rm = TRUE)
sd_bio <- sd(bio_per_child$Bio_Pla_dif,   na.rm = TRUE)
levels_bio <- c(m_bio - sd_bio, m_bio, min(m_bio + sd_bio, 3))

# --- 2. Plant - bucket difference across the whole range ---------------------
levels(dsb_long$patient)   # pairs() computes FIRST level minus SECOND level
flip <- FALSE              # set to TRUE if the first level is the bucket,
                           # so the plot shows plant minus bucket
summary(model1 <- lmer(severity_h ~ patient*Bio_Pla_dif + Prestorer_Order + Prestorer_Shape + Maction_Order + (1|ID_new), data = dsb_long))

diff_over <- function(at_vals) {
  emm <- emmeans(model1, ~ patient | Bio_Pla_dif,
                 at = list(Bio_Pla_dif = at_vals),
                 lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
  out <- summary(pairs(emm, reverse = flip), infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
  as.data.frame(out)
}

x_max     <- 3          # maximum possible score
grid      <- seq(-2, x_max, length.out = 200)
diff_grid <- diff_over(grid)
diff_pts  <- diff_over(levels_bio)
print(diff_pts)   # estimates, CIs and p-values at -1 SD, mean, +1 SD

# --- 3. Labels for the three follow-up points --------------------------------
p_to_star <- function(p) case_when(p < .001 ~ "***", p < .01 ~ "**",
                                   p < .05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "n.s.")
diff_pts$star  <- p_to_star(diff_pts$p.value)
diff_pts$Level <- c("-1 SD", "Mean", "Max")

# --- 4. Plot -----------------------------------------------------------------
Fig2.5 <- ggplot(diff_grid, aes(Bio_Pla_dif, estimate)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
              fill = "#009E73", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(colour = "#009E73", linewidth = 1.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = levels_bio, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(data = diff_pts,
                  aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                  shape = 23, fill = "darkred", colour = "black",
                  size = 0.8, stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = diff_pts,
            aes(y = upper.CL + 0.15, label = star), size = 5) +
  geom_text(data = diff_pts,
            aes(y = min(diff_grid$lower.CL) - 0.15, label = Level),
            size = 2, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = -2:3) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, x_max), ylim = c(-2.4, 1.4), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Biology knowledge",
       y = "Difference in harm evaluation\n(plant \u2212 bucket)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "grey91", linewidth = 0.4),
        axis.title.x       = element_text(face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.margin        = margin(15, 25, 10, 10))

#Edit for sharing
ggsave(filename = "includepath.png",
       plot     = Fig2.5,
       width    = 3,
       height   = 3.5,
       units    = "in",
       dpi      = 300,
       bg       = "white")
```
